title: ASARS Industrial-ROS Profile v0.1-draft
description: ASARS payload extension for factory robotics and ROS-based industrial systems. Draft status — seeking review from robotics integration and functional-safety practitioners.

robot_cell_id.description: Identifier for the robot cell or workcell.

ros_node_name.description: ROS node name at observation time, if applicable.

topic_or_service.description: Fully qualified topic or service name, if applicable.

frame_id.description: TF or message frame_id when spatial context applies.

safety_plc_signature_hash.description: Hash of the active safety PLC program or safety configuration snapshot, if applicable.

outcome.description: Whether the observed action was allowed or blocked.

notes: Draft profile. The core ASARS attestation envelope is unchanged. This schema sketches common industrial-ROS observability fields; field names and enums are expected to co-evolve with implementers.
